title: program/evidence/<ID>/acceptance.json
description: A QA acceptance bound to one evidence file and one source commit. Documents the shape for readers. Setting a task to done requires every listed key, the decision accepted_development, the role qa and the task's own ID.

evidence_sha256.description: sha256 of the results.json that was reviewed

commands.description: the commands QA re-ran, in the results.json command shape

planted_bugs.description: the planted bugs QA re-ran, in the results.json row shape
